input.question: Where is feedback?
input.answer:
You can provide feedback directly through our contact form. 

* **If you are signed in:** You can submit a "Feedback" case through the shared contact form.
* **If you are not signed in:** You can use the support email link or sign in with Google to access the form.
expectedBehavior: Answer or offer a registered customer-clicked route; do not navigate or create a case automatically.

references.content: TableCards creates downloadable place-card PDFs. It does not sell paper, printing, delivery or reprints. The current deployment is a no-charge preview. Displayed offer prices describe launch hypotheses; checkout is a labelled simulation, not a real payment or paid subscription. Do not call mock access paid access. Import and preview are public; saving, exporting and AI backgrounds require Google sign-in. The landing page has product examples, pricing and FAQ. General Q&A does not require sign-in. Google is the only enabled login method. Do not offer password reset, email login, Apple login or support-managed account recovery. If the customer cannot sign in, they may email support for general help; this does not bypass product authentication. A lack of reported events is unknown, not proof nothing happened.

Exports are digital PDFs. Customers arrange printing themselves. Use actual size / 100%, not Fit to page. Use the separate print-test PDF and check its calibration square before a full event. Normal exports contain card sheets only, without a calibration page. Paper size and printer margins must match the selected layout. TableCards cannot guarantee compatibility with a specific printer or print shop. Preview every card, names and table labels before exporting. Longer names may use up to two balanced lines; names are not silently truncated. Latin accented names, including Vietnamese, are supported; unsupported scripts, remaining unsupported combining marks or impossible text fits fail explicitly before export. Do not claim every language/script works. A server event saying PDF made available does not prove it was downloaded, saved to a device or printed. If a customer reports a missing PDF, ask what they see and their browser/device as needed; never ask for a complete private guest list. Use only permitted reported outcomes, not product database reads.

Customers can paste one name per line or a tabular grid, or import CSV/XLSX. Map guest name, optional table and optional short marker columns. Confirm whether the first row contains headings. Import does not intentionally merge, sort or silently drop guests. Review the imported rows and final preview; suggest a small synthetic example when diagnosing formatting. Never request a private guest list. Saving requires a signed-in selected workspace. Unsaved changes are protected during normal navigation/sign-in; do not promise recovery after the documented draft storage expires or across unrelated browsers/devices. Saved projects belong to the workspace selected when they were saved. Switching to a different workspace does not move the project. input.question: שלום, הדפסתי את הכרטיסים והם קטנים מדי. ההגדרה הייתה Fit to Page. איך מתקנים?
input.answer:
שלום,

הסיבה שהכרטיסים יצאו קטנים מדי היא השימוש בהגדרה "Fit to Page" (התאם לעמוד), אשר מכווצת את הקובץ כדי שיתאים לשולי המדפסת.

כדי לתקן זאת, עליך להדפיס את ה-PDF מחדש ולבחור בהגדרות ההדפסה באפשרות **"Actual Size" (גודל אמיתי)** או **"100%"**.

בנוסף, וודא שגודל הנייר שנבחר בהגדרות ההדפסה תואם בדיוק לגודל הנייר שבו אתה משתמש.
expectedBehavior: Produce a concise, natural Hebrew suggested reply with Actual Size / 100% and the separate print-test PDF; English setting labels are appropriate.
No mixed Arabic fragments, printer guarantee, claimed project changes or claim that this suggested reply has already been sent.

input.question: Does the AI keep an uploaded logo exactly?
input.answer:
No, using an uploaded logo or icon as inspiration for the AI does not guarantee an exact reproduction. The AI uses your image to help generate style and themes, but it may not recreate the logo perfectly.

If you want your logo to appear exactly as it is, you should upload it as **custom artwork** rather than using it for AI inspiration. For custom artwork, ensure your file meets these requirements:
* **Format:** PNG or JPEG
* **Size:** At least 1050 × 600 pixels (and no more than 2 megapixels or 10 MiB)
* **Note:** PNGs should be eight-bit or lower, and the images cannot be animated or rotated.

If you have joined a Studio workspace through an invitation, it will be listed there alongside your private workspace. If you are looking for a workspace that belongs to a different Google account, you will need to sign in with that specific account.
